the low phosphorus stress on the physiological metabolism was not obvious in the stabilization leaf and root of Hevea, but the low phosphorus was not good for the young leaf and stem.

the low P stress can increase the SSC and SPC of stabilization leaf and the root,and decrease the SSC of root, stem and leaf, SPC of young leaves and stems,and chlorophyll content and NR activity of stabilization leaf, root activity.
low phosphorus stress can improve the photosynthetic ability of Hevea, but it can also cause a certain extent of metabolic imbalance in the plant.

the physiological metabolism of the seedlings in the different phoshorus stress levels,and the results provide a theoretical basis for the study of phoshorus stress on the seedlings of Hevea brasiliensis.
the effect of P stress on the physiological metabolism and the growth of Hevea.
the effects of low phosphorus stress on the physiological metabolism in the Hevea seedlings.

the low phoshorus could stimulate the physiological metabolism of the Hevea seedlings.

the physiological metabolism of seedling was influenced by low phosphorus stress,and the low phoshorus level could increase the soluble protein content in root and stabilization leaf,and the chlorophyll content,but the soluble sugar content and root activity were reduced.

low phosphorus stress can increase the content of soluble sugar,proteins,chlorophyll,and nitrate reductases in hevea seedling,which can promote the physiological metabolism of hevea seedlings and improve the adaptability to phosphorus stress.
